hero.name: Rurik

vitals.label: Hit Points
vitals.description: Hit Points represent durability and the will to live. Your Hit Point maximum is the number you have when uninjured; current Hit Points can be any number from that maximum down to 0.

vitals.label: Armor Class
vitals.description: Armor Class is the target fact read by attacks through `target.effective('srd/ac')`. Its unarmored value is computed at generation time per entity as 10 + Dexterity modifier; every legal attack target must carry an explicit seed because unseeded fact reads fail closed.

vitals.label: Character Level
vitals.description: Your character's level, from 1 to 20. Gaining a level increases your capabilities.

identityDetails.label: Soldier

identityDetails.label: Human
identityDetails.description: Human species. Size: Medium or Small. Speed: 30 feet.
